visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a black New Era baseball cap and a black hoodie with an Evangelion print, is seen in a warehouse or backroom. He is standing and typing on a grey laptop that rests on a stack of cardboard boxes. The background is filled with tall industrial shelves packed with various hobby and model kit boxes, primarily Gundam. (2) The man turns and walks away from the laptop, passing a glass-door display case filled with figurines. He exits the room and begins walking down a narrow staircase. The walls of the staircase are covered in colorful posters featuring anime characters and model kits. (3) He exits the building and enters a bright outdoor urban street. A long line of people is queued up on the sidewalk next to a tall residential building. Many individuals in the crowd are holding up smartphones to film or photograph him as he emerges. (4) The man walks along the sidewalk, moving past the long queue. He gestures with his hands, greeting the people in line and occasionally stopping to interact or pose for a quick photo. The crowd consists of people of various ages, mostly wearing casual attire like jackets and masks. (5) The man continues his walk down the street, reaching a point where the line ends near a large building entrance. He turns back to the camera, smiling and adjusting his glasses while continuing to converse.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a natural conversational exchange between a man and a woman in an indoor setting. Their voices are clear and casual, with standard room tone. (2) As the man moves, a upbeat and festive synthesized BGM track begins to fade in. The music has a steady, rhythmic electronic beat and a cheerful major-mode melody. (3) Transitioning to the outdoor scene, the BGM remains steady while a distinct layer of crowd chatter and environmental urban noise is added. The man's voice becomes more projected and high-pitched as he greets the crowd, frequently saying phrases like 'Happy New Year' in Mandarin. (4) The audio continues with the interplay of the festive music, the man's enthusiastic dialogue, and the background murmurs of the fans. Occasional incidental sounds of footsteps on the sidewalk are audible under the primary audio tracks.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a popular hobby store owner (Mr. Joe) interacting with a massive line of fans during a New Year event. It aims to showcase the popularity of his brand and his personal connection with his community.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is centered around the store 'Mr. Joe Hobby' and the presence of numerous Gundam and Bandai model kits.
